title.fr: Oscillations électriques forcées en régime sinusoïdal

sketch:
Observe: SVG schematic (R, L, C, GBF at pulsation ω) left; polyline
shows steady-state i(t) = I_max·cos(ωt − φ) with I_max = U_max/Z(ω)
and Z = √(R² + (Lω − 1/(Cω))²). Student sweeps ω; resonance curve
I_max(ω) drawn beneath, peak at ω₀ = 1/√(LC). Experiment: 3 seeded
target I_max values; student picks ω. Evaluate: live i(t) hidden;
only I_max target and Z HUD; submit ω blind. Wrinkle: phase φ
tan(φ) = (Lω − 1/(Cω))/R also probed as a secondary target.
